name: LDAP Injection
attack_scenario: attacker submits a username like '*)(uid=*))(|(uid=*' to break out of the intended filter, turning a single-user lookup into a wildcard match or an authentication bypass
negative_test_hint: submit username = "*)(uid=*" and assert the search does not match all entries

exemplar.compliant:
tmpl = "(uid=%s)"
safe = ldap.filter.escape_filter_chars(username)
conn.search_s(base, ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE, tmpl % safe)
exemplar.explanation: escape user input with escape_filter_chars before placing it in an LDAP filter
